race.title: ARC 1M Bonus Handicap
race.verdict: A few of these arrive with a question mark against them and it could pay to side with REY DE LA BATALLA , who hinted at a revival when fourth at Kempton last time and can race off a 1 lb lower mark now. In-form Valentine Boy could prove the chief threat, although Sant Alessio is also weighted to go well if back on song. REY DE LA BATALLA VALENTINE BOY SANT ALESSIO (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Valentine Boy (10/3), Penfolds Grange (5/1), Rey De La Batalla (11/2), The Bitter Moose (6/1), Way To Dubai (15/2), Sant Alessio (10/1), Spirit Of Breeze (10/1), Dandy G Boy (12/1), Jazzy Baby (16/1), North View (20/1), Nordic Norm (25/1), Secret Message (25/1)
